title: Retain the free affine radius and a nonlinear scalar defect
statement: Let the normalized accepted Burkholder density U=27(3|q|-|p|)(|p|+|q|)^3/16. For ANY r>=0 apply its quasiconvexity to the SAME actual periodic potential at four affine means (p0,q),p0=r omega q,omega=1,i,-1,-i. Exact four-point average is P+4r^2a+r^4Q. The scalar majorant therefore gives P+4r^2a<=81D+E(r)Q,E(r)=(r-3)^2(11r^2+66r+135)/16. r=3 recovers the inherited producer bound. Retaining t=r-3>=0 gives E(3+t)=27t^2+33t^3/4+11t^4/16. Choose t=a/[4(Q+a)] in[0,1/4] ifQ+a>0;define zero case continuously. Using7451/256<30,the retained defect is at least(33/8)a^2/(Q+a)>=4a^2/(Q+a). Hence P+36a+4a^2/(Q+a)<=81D. Extra term equals4|q|^2 S^2/(|q|^2+S),zero atq0. This retains a JOINT nonlinear mean/fluctuation term,not another independent reserve or field/moment oracle. Actual rational moments give fixed rational work;realW1,4 input uses paid approximation,not unit-cost evaluation.
